title: com.clodhub/gift-card-purchase
description: A document of the giftCardPurchases collection as com.clodhub/records exports it.

kind.description: amount: worth its face value; item: one service (or a pack of sessions of it), worth that service's full price whatever it costs at booking.

amount.description: What the card cost: the face value of an amount card, the price paid for an item card or pack.

itemName.description: The service's name; empty for an amount card.

itemSlug.description: The service's catalogue slug when known.

recipientEmail.description: An email address, trimmed and in lower case.

senderEmail.description: An email address, trimmed and in lower case.

message.description: The sender's message; may be empty.

language.description: A language code such as en or es.

promotionId.description: The promotion a pack was bought under; null for a single card.

sessionsTotal.description: 1, or a pack's number of sessions.

token.description: The buyer's secret: with the id it reads the purchase (newToken, crypto.randomUUID by default).

status.description: Stored state; views report a pending checkout past expiresAt as expired.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code in upper case, such as EUR.

payment.description: checkout: the provider's page; sheet: an app's payment sheet.

checkoutId.description: The payment's id (a checkout, or a sheet payment), which the issued card keeps as its checkoutId; null only while the payment is being started.

expiresAt.description: When a checkout stops accepting payment: 24 hours after createdAt, as com.clodhub/payments gives a checkout without an end; null for a sheet payment, which does not expire.

paidAt.description: When the payment issued the card.

date.description: A date as a records export writes it.
